verdict.rationale: Lindy is an AI teammate SaaS, so headless or CI invocation is a fair axis for it. The evidence shows only Slack and chat interfaces plus in-product scheduled routines, which are an adjacent automation feature rather than a headless or CI run mode. No CLI, API, or CI integration is documented, and the OpenAPI probe paths all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
